commentary_title: Freight rates fail to catch up to trade activity

commentary_summary: The VLCC tonne-miles index ended the week at 108.5 points. commentary_title: Resilient Asian import demand and Atlantic exports support VLCC activity
commentary_summary: VLCC utilisation stood at 89.6% indicating stronger vessel employment as more ships moved from waiting positions into active trading. Chinese discharge activity stabilised after recent weakness, while India continued to demonstrate steady crude import requirements.
